labels.title: Roles and access
labels.lead: Who may do what in the CRM. The tables are built from the real roles in the database, so they always match the actual rights.
labels.desc_owner: Sees and changes everything: settings, users, prices, wages, revenue, licence.
labels.ownerNote: The manager is combined with the owner for now: with no separate manager, work at this level.
labels.desc_manager: Runs the day: stock, mailings, revenue and reports. Does not see wages.
labels.desc_operator: Works the counter: orders, customers, bookings, taking payment. Sees no revenue or wages.
labels.desc_workers: They do not sign in to the CRM. They take works and clock in on the tablet with a PIN.
labels.notSelf: You cannot demote your own account.
labels.noRole: This role has not been created yet.
labels.drift: This role was edited by hand and differs from the preset in:
labels.noRoleUsersHint: No role and not an administrator — they see nothing. Assign a level.
labels.footer: All other roles and fine-grained rights are in the standard section
labels.cap_ordersEdit: Edit orders and bookings, take payment
labels.w_can1: See the work queue and take free works
labels.w_can2: Start and finish their own works
labels.w_no3: See order money, customers or others' wages
